statement: Exactly eleven mixed genus-three classes have projective-plane quotient; four are identified with B34, seven are additional. Together with B37 this completes all 156 classes with spherical positive quotient.
manuscript_passages: Part B(f) of the task; genus-three projective-plane quotient subcatalogue
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None: all quotient types and covering homomorphisms are explicit.
notes: Complete source fusion proved by colored disc braids and one-sided puncture slides. All group products, NEC relations, local injections, Euler characteristics and section posets computed. Four exact hyperelliptic overlap maps identify the already counted rows.
